title: Phase Transition of a Semiflexible Membrane in Two Dimensions
summary: We study a two-dimensional semiflexible membrane model whose formal Hamiltonian is given by $H[φ]=\sum_x \bigl(\|\nabla φ_x\|^2 +N^λ|Δφ_x|^2\bigr)$, interpolating between the discrete Gaussian free field (DGFF) and the membrane model (MM). We analyze its finite-volume covariance in the bulk as $N\to\infty$, and identify distinct regimes depending on the parameter $λ$. For $λ 2$, it agrees with the rescaled MM covariance up to a negligible error.
